Pexels API JavaScript client, version 1.4.0 (npm package "pexels"),
https://github.com/pexels/pexels-javascript . Licence: MIT, as declared in the
package's package.json. This is the package's own dist/main.umd.js, unchanged.
The theme uses it only on the Theme Options screen, on the Images tab
(assets/js/admin-images.js). It sends the key to api.pexels.com from the
administrator's browser. The theme never prints the key on the public site.
